name: Sonnet deep value
strategy: Round 2: rotate into unloved cyclical/value large-caps (energy, financials, autos, healthcare) that missed the AI-led melt-up, add small-cap value beta via IWM, and run a small levered short-BTC hedge against a continuing crypto bear, holding sizable cash for drawdown buys.

reassessment_note: Unrestricted-retail resize (2026-07-30, free internet + no sizing caps): Deep-value cyclical rotation thesis is confirmed by the tape: XOM +30% YTD/+15% 1mo on the Mideast oil spike (earnings due 7/31, BofA cut to Neutral on 'limited upside' near its new $158 PT vs $156.75 spot -> trim into the print); GM +8.9%/1mo and F +9.0%/1mo both beat and raised guidance (F also landed a large military contract, Citi upgrade) -> add to both; UNH crushed Q2 (EPS beat 56% YoY, raised FY guide, +27% YTD) -> modest add, valuation has already re-rated some so not oversizing; JPM fell 3.5% today with Dimon flagging macro/valuation caution and 'bank stocks drop from highs ahead of Fed' -> trim; IWM is -3.5% 1mo despite +16% YTD, the small-cap catch-up stalled -> trim; PFE unchanged, earnings 8/4 still pending; BTC short hedge kept small per mandate despite a +6.3% 1mo BTC bounce since the multi-quarter downtrend (-24%/6mo, -46%/1yr) is intact. Net effect: rotate weight from stretched/weakening names into names with freshly confirmed catalysts, and raise cash slightly for the mandate's drawdown-buying dry powder.
